# `media/codecs/MpegIntra.js`

> **Source:** `engine/media/codecs/MpegIntra.js`

Authored ISO/IEC 11172-2 / ITU-T H.262 elementary-stream subset. All pictures are progressive I pictures, each 8x8 block contains its DC coefficient only. This is intentionally coarse compression, not a general MPEG decoder. VLC codes are normative H.262 Annex B tables B.12/B.13 (also MPEG-1).
